name: L3-D X-only layered predictive chain experiment, new user definition
learner: linear X-only reduced-rank predictive representation with current-X bypass; dimension chosen by validation future-X MSE; no graph/hidden count labels
dimension_selection: minimum validation trajectory-mean MSE, within1e-6 choose smaller
hidden_answers: access only after predictive checkpoint freeze; diagnostic probes fit validation answers only; oracle labeled-state reference isolated
layer1: selected latent coordinates plus current X constitute predictive state; joint and coordinate Y/Z diagnostics after freeze
layer2: leave-one-L-out X_t+1 forecasting conditional on all other L: current X diagnostic vs full20 X main; report h1/2/4/8 separately
layer3: learn directed candidate VAR lag1 andlag5 relations, and explicit L-source screening under full covered X history; do not invent upper layers if no direct state survives
layer4: both directions, all-other-node histories controlled; then full covered X history (20+p-1) additional control; no real intervention
edge_rule: validation relative MSE reduction >=1% selects candidate before test; independent test reports gain and paired trajectory CI; supported edge additionally test gain>=1% andCI lower>0
oracle: same lagged conditional forecasts on full observed [Y,Z,X], training truth allowed only in isolated ideal reference, not X-only encoder/graph learner
rotation: predeclared fixed-rank2 capacity diagnostic; orthogonal theta0,pi/8,pi/4,pi/2; predictor transforms inversely so forecast unchanged; compare conditional directed candidates
claim: predictive edges are not causal proof; general X-only Gaussian graph nonuniqueness guard retained
statistics: paired independent trajectories, not timepoints; bootstrap1000; no selection on test; all seeds and groups retained
excluded: L3-D old meaning classifier with extra-information calibration
forcing latent count equal true hidden count
